UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call 'AI slop'. Avoid this: create a distinctive, award-worthy frontend that surprises and delights.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as cheap gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions like transition: all. Always add transitions for specific properties (transform, opacity, border-color, background-color).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Preserve left-aligned reading flow.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp technical buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react icons exclusively.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, click feedback, scroll-triggered reveals, and active nav highlighting.
Use generous spacing (2-3x more spacing than default). Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes for automated testing.
